cardEffects: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Eosmon] and 1 [Menoa Bellucci] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, by placing this Digimon as 1 of your [Eosmon]'s bottom digivolution card, you may play 1 [Menoa Bellucci] from your hand without paying the cost.
inheritedEffect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When another [Eosmon] is played, this Digimon may digivolve into an [Eosmon] in your hand, reducing the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
name: Morphomon

rulings.answer: Yes, you can add just 1 card to your hand when only 1 or the other is revealed.
rulings.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck with this card's [On Play] effect don't contain both [Eosmon] and [Menoa Bellucci], do I still get to add a card to my hand?

rulings.answer: No, you can't. You must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
rulings.question: When the cards revealed from my deck with this card's [On Play] effect contain both [Eosmon] and [Menoa Bellucci], am I allowed to add just one card to my hand?

rulings.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve into [Eosmon] in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
